digest.component_or_area: LLM framework / structured output / prompt cache
propositions: Live Anthropic structured output canary with prompt caching executes two identical-prefix calls (write/read) and records usage counts: call 1 (write) input_tokens=10759, cache_write_tokens=10697, cache_read_tokens=0; call 2 (read) input_tokens=10759, cache_write_tokens=0, cache_read_tokens=10697, with requests=1 on both.

Live Bedrock structured output canary with prompt caching executes the same two-call sequence and records usage counts: call 1 (write) input_tokens=10747, cache_write_tokens=10685, cache_read_tokens=0; call 2 (read) input_tokens=10747, cache_write_tokens=0, cache_read_tokens=10685, with requests=1 on both.

Complete-vs-omit branch observes no failed intermediate responses on either provider; the COMPLETE branch fires on every request with messages_in=1, messages_kept=1, omitted=0; the OMIT branch is unexercised (not a divergence from the happy-path contract).

Observed cache accounting matches the documented contract in docs/llm-framework.md for all exercisable counts: exactly one outer run per call, no transport retry model requests added, zero output retries consumed, cache read/write/input relationships consistent with inclusive-input convention (uncached input = 62 tokens on both providers).

Mixed-provider fallback chains (Bedrock + Anthropic) resolve to prompt_cache_style='none' with cache_read_tokens=0 and cache_write_tokens=0 due to incompatible cache key formats; this behavior is not documented in the accounting section of docs/llm-framework.md and is filed as a separate documentation follow-up ticket.
